newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Oil, Showa Shell mull refining merger.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Oil, Showa Shell mull refining merger.

text.p: Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd said on Sunday it was considering merging its oil refining division with that of Showa Shell Sekiyu KK.
In a brief statement, Mitsubishi Oil said it was studying the possibility of a merger as a way to streamline its business operations. It gave no details.
Officials of Showa Shell were not immediately available for comment.
The merger, if completed, would create Japan's biggest oil refining company, surpassing Nippon Oil Co Ltd.
A joint refining venture would mark a de facto merger of Showa and Mitsubishi, Japan's fifth- and sixth-largest oil distributors, since it would tie them up in a large segment of their operations.
